assertions.text: Checks for uncommitted changes before doing anything else (Pre-flight step 1-3)
Invokes the mandatory cross-model-review gate (Pre-flight step 4) before step 1's git push, unconditionally
Re-resolves the PR template (.github/pull_request_template.md, else the bundled asset) rather than assuming one
Asks draft-vs-ready-to-merge via AskUserQuestion rather than assuming draft
Validates the PR title via check-pr-title.py before gh pr create
Resolves an assignee (gh api user, falling back to the repo owner) before gh pr create
Writes the gh-pr-create marker immediately before gh pr create, not earlier
Final narrated gh pr create command includes --assignee and either --draft or no --draft, consistent with the stated draft-vs-ready answer
